charter.origin: Owner-approved clarification drafted in PR #15; included in this branch; not yet merged to main.

identity: Sophon is an organizational normative semantic layer: shared, source-grounded, versioned governing meaning, complementary to existing BI/data semantics and directly queryable by non-BI agents/humans.
product_wedge: First integration wedge: independently check governing contract meaning against pre-existing, native BI semantic definitions; do not rebuild the data semantic layer.
two_directions: Independent implementation-to-governance recheck after system/semantic changes
non_goals: LLM accuracy leaderboard as a substitute for cumulative learning
Inventing a proprietary DSL as an MVP prerequisite
Presenting a source-grounded prediction as legal approval or deployed compliance
Rediscovering established components instead of reading their actual code

current_work.active: Owner research focus: independently investigate whether source-grounded contractual provision knowledge can accumulate and transfer contract-by-contract. Choose the smallest discriminating next test from V1-V3 evidence; no new implementation or experiment has been authorized.
current_work.blocked: V3 source-grounded label adjudication remains unfinished; cloud source retrieval previously had CONNECT 403. This is a V3-specific limitation, not an automatic gate on all cumulative-learning research.
current_work.on_hold: V4 sequential contract-learning specification PR #18 remains UNRUN. V3 manual 78-unit review is not an automatic priority. BI expansion, full contract-to-agent propagation, EDGAR transformer training, and commercial validation are not the immediate increment.
current_work.horizon: Predict reusable normative provision structures, conditional on evidenced law, contract family, ToC/section and observed provisions; test cumulative, auditable contract-by-contract improvement, not superiority to a pretrained LLM.

working_rules: Before recommending architecture, consult established_components and inspect referenced source on its ref; do not present existing Jev/adversarial/backward/library/reconciliation as new.
Distinguish DESIGNED, IMPLEMENTED, RUN, OBSERVED, VALIDATED; separate frozen primary from post-hoc secondary results.
For any new experiment/results or changed architecture, update this state in the SAME PR and cite evidence.
Check branch ancestry and relevant open PRs; components listed on unmerged PRs are not necessarily present in the current checkout.
Legal provenance, unknowns, known-at versus effective-at, adversarial counterexamples and independent audit are requirements, not add-ons.
Do not assume user approval for paid calls, merger of draft PRs or charter changes.
Treat LLM agreement as triage, not independently validated semantic truth; minimize human labor without hiding correlated errors.

Mandatory development process: read ENGINEERING_WORKFLOW.md; human proposes the problem (technical concepts are hypotheses), engineering agents own independent choice of design, challenge needless complexity, implement one bounded, testable increment and make KEEP/REVISE/STOP recommendation without making the owner referee routine implementation choices.

engineering_workflow.idea_screening_gate: Before initiating research or development on an attractive new idea, apply ENGINEERING_WORKFLOW.md Idea-screening gate: reconcile current code/results and prior art; distinguish outcome from mechanism and charter scope; compare a competent baseline under blind, independently valid tests; preregister stop rules; preserve failures; authorize only one minimal increment.
engineering_workflow.rule: Owner owns problem/outcome/constraints and material decisions; engineering agents independently choose/challenge design and simplest alternatives; implement one small falsifiable increment, verify actual results, then KEEP/REVISE/STOP.

research_priority.owner_stated: Immediate research priority is cumulative, source-grounded contractual learning across successive contracts, NOT commercial demand validation or immediate deployment of a full downstream agent-configuration workflow.
research_priority.motivating_scenario: A solo founder operates an AI-native company with multiple agents and receives new agreements/amendments. The same applicable, versioned contractual meaning should be reusable by those agents without re-interpreting everything from scratch. This is a north-star technical scenario, NOT a request to build the full automation pipeline next.
research_priority.immediate_unknown: Can a persistent, provisional, evidence-linked library of contractual provision structures improve later contract interpretation/prediction, omission detection or human-review burden against a competent frozen/no-library and raw-prior-examples baseline, with independently checked unseen cases?
research_priority.established_starting_point: V1 Jev + independently invoked adversarial/backward reviewers + deterministic reconciliation; V2 provisional provision library (no observed incremental lift on its near-ceiling proxy); V3 contextual heading-label predictions (frozen INCONCLUSIVE, repaired secondary provisional); V4 sequential learning only specified, not run. All of this code is on the PR #17 branch (b9d698c), not on this branch or main; branch from #17 and bring this guard/state across rather than redesigning.
research_priority.exclusions: Do not mistake the solo-founder scenario for authorization to implement contract-to-agent configuration/propagation now. Do not substitute E0-E5 feasibility, commercial interviews, or another narrow lab demo for a discriminating cumulative-learning test. EDGAR-only transformer and autonomous machine-to-machine contracting are related exploratory ideas, not automatically Sophon roadmap commitments.
research_priority.engineering_discretion: Engineer independently choose no-code analysis, reuse or a single smallest falsifiable experiment; do not assume V3's 78-item manual adjudication must be completed first. Do not initiate paid calls or code solely from this priority statement.
